sources.name: Spring 2027 Konkuk Undergraduate Admissions Guidelines for International Students (English)
Konkuk University International Student Center — Admission Guidelines

english_taught_degrees.detail: English-track admission for Computer Software and International Commerce & Business (International College)
english_taught_degrees.evidence: International Commerce & Business ... (Submit either Korean- or English-language transcripts, depending on the application language track.) ① TOPIK Lv. 4 or higher ... or ⑤ TOEFL iBT score of 71 or higher ... ⑥ IELTS score of 5.5 or higher ⑦ CEFR level B2 or higher ⑧ NEW TEPS score of 327 or higher
